scope: Independent primitive boundary/window, mixed legacy and original-created repository, mode-switch dedup, authenticated MAC/frame/index corruption and pre-output refusal. Original accepts 17 MiB decoded snapshot metadata deliberately beyond the candidate 16 MiB subset.

referencedFrozenLegacyWriter.authentication: Expected source hash checked before its first fixture operation and again after the complete independent run.

explicitAcceptanceDeviation: Original check --read-data accepts a valid snapshot followed by 17 MiB JSON whitespace; candidate check/restore reject it under the documented 16 MiB decoded metadata subset before output. This is a bounded-reader limitation, not a format-equality match.
additionalChecks: Repeated identical 1 MiB source chunks share IDs, and a 17-byte tail has a distinct ID.
Mode switch preserves existing uncompressed/compressed data records without adding duplicate data blobs.
All eight candidate corruption/metadata cases reject check and restore with no destination created and no app-owned lock left before original execution.
512 KiB or smaller frame windows, disabled checksums, empty blobs/metadata, growing single-byte frames, exact 16 MiB and excess input boundaries.
